titles.title: American Tariff Rebate Act
American Tariff Rebate Act
To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to provide American tariff rebates, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, and Homeland Security, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
